_doc: The video the human plays on their phone in S45-S46 (scripts/phone_dialer.py -> deliverables/phone/): an invented dialer, no real phone's interface. The pledge number is typed on the post-roll's DTMF timing (config/postroll.json), the call screen shows 'Calling' over the ring, then 'On hold' with a timer through the hold music, to the end of the post-roll: no hang-up on screen (the human, 2026-10-27). Its sound is the whole post-roll's, so the tones heard on set line up with the post mix (R2). Times are seconds from the song's end (post-roll time), except lead_in.
lead_in_note: the empty keypad before the first digit, to start the video and lift the phone
